name: deck-mixer
description: Turn a library of Markdown case studies into branded, editable PowerPoint decks.
long_description: Builds reference, capabilities, tender and plan decks from your own case library, in your own colours, logo and template. Add at least one API key for the real result: a free Gemini key (aistudio.google.com/apikey) lets an AI art director design your slides and generates their images. Without keys decks still build, but look basic: rule-based layouts and grey image placeholders. Confidential cases are anonymised on every slide and in the speaker notes. Leave the case library empty to try the built-in sample cases.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List and filter the cases in the case library

tools.name: create_reference_deck
tools.description: Deep-dive deck on one or more cases

tools.name: create_tender_deck
tools.description: Evidence deck for a tender or pitch

tools.name: create_plan_deck
tools.description: Deck from any markdown plan or proposal

tools.name: add_case
tools.description: Add a case to the library, checking for duplicates first

tools.name: remove_case
tools.description: Archive (or delete) a case from the library

tools.name: preview_image
tools.description: Generate one test image with the current settings

library_path.title: Case library
library_path.description: Folder with your cases (see CASE_LIBRARY_SCHEMA.md). Leave empty to try the built-in sample cases.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where decks are saved. Default: a 'decks' folder on your Desktop.

theme_path.title: Brand theme
theme_path.description: Optional theme.yaml with your colours, fonts and logo.

brand_description.title: Brand description
brand_description.description: Optional, used when no theme file is set, e.g. 'calm, trustworthy, navy and sand'. Needs an AI key.

template_path.title: PowerPoint template
template_path.description: Optional 16:9 .pptx/.potx company template to build on.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key (recommended)
gemini_api_key.description: Strongly recommended: one free key covers AI slide design (text) and image generation. Get it at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Without any key, decks look basic.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: AI slide design (text) with Claude. Pair it with an image key (Gemini or OpenAI).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: AI slide design (text) and image generation.
